page_title: ATA 3-2 ACM | Atalanta v AC Milan 09/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+9' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Federico La Penna stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
90+8' The manager makes a subsitution with Emil Holm (Atalanta) coming on for Matteo Ruggeri.
90+5' 3 - 2 GOAL! Luis Muriel (Atalanta) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Aleksey Miranchuk provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 3:2.
90+3' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) sees a yellow card in the hand of Federico La Penna. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Davide Calabria (AC Milan) is sent from the pitch.
90+3' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
88' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Luka Jovic (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
88' Stefano Pioli decides to make a substitution. Tijjani Reijnders will be replaced by Yacine Adli (AC Milan).
87' It's time for a substitution. Michel Adopo (Atalanta) comes on in place of Mario Pasalic.
85' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
85' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Mike Maignan punches the ball away.
84' Fine play by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
82' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) replacing Ademola Lookman.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Charles De Ketelaere walks off the pitch to be replaced by Luis Muriel (Atalanta).
81' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) picks up a yellow card.
80' 2 - 2 Goal! Luka Jovic (AC Milan) scores after an assist by Christian Pulisic that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 2:2.
79' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) tries his luck with a low long-range effort after receiving a precise pass, but Juan Musso has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.

76' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Mike Maignan easily deals with the threat. Well-positioned Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
75' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
72' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek makes his way off the pitch and Luka Jovic (AC Milan) comes on as his replacement.
72' Ederson (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Federico La Penna had an easy-decision to make.

71' What an opportunity! Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes low towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Federico La Penna didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) has a snap shot at goal from distance after a rebound falls his way, but the effort is wild and flies miles over the bar.
68' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
67' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) launches a cross from the corner, but Mike Maignan is alert to thwart the effort.
63' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
62' Federico La Penna interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta). There is a free kick near the sideline to AC Milan.
59' Samuel Chukwueze comes off the pitch to be replaced by Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan).

55' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Charles De Ketelaere, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), who beats Mike Maignan with a brilliant shot into the top of the net. 2:1.
54' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
53' The game is interrupted now, Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
51' Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
51' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) latches onto a loose ball inside the box, but his first-time strike at goal is blocked by a defender.
50' Atalanta force their opponents to concede a corner.
50' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.
47' A precise short pass from Ruben Loftus-Cheek releases Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the right post.
46' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ederson (Atalanta). Federico La Penna saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. AC Milan will take a free kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Federico La Penna blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+3' 1 - 1 The ball was swung into the box by Alessandro Florenzi from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Olivier Giroud (AC Milan), who planted a bullet header inside the left post to make the score 1:1.
45+3' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
45+2' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Tijjani Reijnders, who fails to shoot.
44' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies well wide of the right post.
41' A pass from Yunus Musah gives Davide Calabria (AC Milan) a shooting opportunity on the edge of the box, but the effort is poor and goes well wide of the right post.
40' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).

40' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.

38' 1 - 0 That's scrappy, but it's a GOAL! The long throw into the box comically bobbles around until pounced on by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta), who scuffs the ball into the net from inside the six-yard box. It's now 1:0.
36' The foul by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) was seen by Federico La Penna who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
34' The referee awards a corner and Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) goes over to take it.

33' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) and Christian Pulisic try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
30' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.

27' The ball from the corner kick lands at the feet of Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) deep inside the box and he takes a shot. The strike heads towards the bottom left corner, but it's deflected away thanks to a brilliant intervention by one of the defenders.
27' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) will take the corner.
26' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
25' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:2. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
23' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) tries to play a long through ball into Charles De Ketelaere, but the defence breaks the move down.
21' AC Milan keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
19' Federico La Penna blows his whistle after Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. AC Milan have a free kick.
15' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
14' Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Ademola Lookman, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
11' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Davide Calabria (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Juan Musso, who smothers the ball.
10' It looks like Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) saw red with that tackle. Federico La Penna won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
9' Good chance! Ademola Lookman laid the ball off to Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
8' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
7' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
7' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
5' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.

2' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Mike Maignan leaps like a salmon to deny him.
2' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner with a short pass.
2' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Federico La Penna.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
